content_html:
WorthBuying Market Watch for November 2026 uses our own repeated price observations across 94 tracked product listings in the USA. It does not treat retailer crossed-out RRPs as price history.

This month, 32 tracked listings were at least 5% away from their observed median after three or more checks. This is a snapshot of individual listings, not a claim about the whole retail market.

Tracked prices that moved lower

  • Bose Solo Soundbar 2 Home Theater, Certified Refurbished — 27% below its observed median; current observation $94.00, median $129.00 across 4 checks.
  • Polti PTNA0018 Vaporetto Smart Steam Mop & Steam Cleaner for Cleaning&Sanitizing — 25% below its observed median; current observation $59.99, median $79.99 across 3 checks.
  • iRobot Roomba Combo j5+ Self-Emptying Robot Vacuum & Mop - Certified Refurbished — 24% below its observed median; current observation $179.99, median $237.49 across 4 checks.
  • 8qt Crock Pot 8qt Slow Cooker Big 10 quart 9 quart 8.5 Quart Huge XL qt Large — 20% below its observed median; current observation $86.73, median $109.11 across 6 checks.
  • iRobot Roomba j7+ Self-Emptying Vacuum Cleaning Robot - Certified Refurbished! — 20% below its observed median; current observation $189.99, median $237.49 across 4 checks.
  • Ninja Luxe Cafe Pro Series 4-in-1 Coffee Machine, Silver (Certified Refurbished) — 18% below its observed median; current observation $491.00, median $599.99 across 7 checks.
  • Ninja CFP105 DualBrew Hot & Iced Coffee Maker (Black) — 16% below its observed median; current observation $67.06, median $79.95 across 9 checks.
  • Shark IP1251 PowerDetect Cordless Stick Vacuum — 12% below its observed median; current observation $174.00, median $198.00 across 7 checks.

Tracked prices that moved higher

  • Cuisinart Air Fryer Toaster Oven 7-in-1 1800W CTOA-122NAS Steel Finish Open Box — 43% above its observed median; current observation $89.95, median $62.97 across 4 checks.
  • Tineco Floor One S3 Pro Smart Cordless All-in-One Vacuum Cleaner, Self-Cleaning — 28% above its observed median; current observation $159.00, median $124.00 across 4 checks.
  • Lenovo - Idea Tab - 11" 2.5K Tablet - 8GB RAM - 128GB UFS - with Tab Pen and ... — 18% above its observed median; current observation $299.99, median $254.99 across 4 checks.
  • ECOVACS DEEBOT T50 PRO Omni Robot Vacuum and Mop 15000Pa - Certified Refurbished — 17% above its observed median; current observation $349.99, median $299.00 across 5 checks.

How to use this data

A lower observed price can be a useful buying signal, but condition, exact model, seller quality, warranty, delivery and returns still matter. Follow the linked buying guide to compare current options before purchasing.

Methodology

We record at most one observation per listing per day when that listing appears in our automated buying-guide research. We only include a listing in this report after at least three valid observations on distinct dates, with a latest check no older than seven days, and we compare its most recent observation with the median of our recorded history. Listings can disappear or change, so this data should not be treated as a market-wide price index.
